reason: The README describes a translation support toolkit focused on segmenting and validating text, extracting terminology, generating tone guidance, and maintaining workspace-scoped translation memory and glossaries.

summaries.zh: 用于辅助翻译工作流的工具包，支持文本分段、术语与术语表处理、源译文质量检查、语气指南以及工作区内的翻译记忆管理。
summaries.en: A translation workflow toolkit that provides text segmentation, terminology and glossary handling, source-target quality checks, tone guidance, and workspace-scoped translation memory.

capabilities: segments translation text into bounded chunks
extracts glossary terms and performs source-target consistency checks
checks numbers, units, brackets, length ratios, and punctuation
reads and writes translation memory and glossary files within the session workspace
